sentences.text: In Re : An application for bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Sankrail PS case no. 75 of 2018 dated 17.7.2018 under section 376(2)(f) IPC and section 6 of the POCSO Act And In Re : Nanda Sing ........ petitioner Ms. Meenal Sinha Ms. K Roy ...... for the petitioner Mr. N Ahmed Ms. Trina Mitra ...... for the State Heard learned lawyers for the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is the father of the minor victim.
It is alleged he had ravished her.
Under such circumstances we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
Accordingly, prayer for bail is rejected.

We request the trial court to conclude the trial at an early date preferably within six months from the next date fixed for recording evidence without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
Parties shall communicate this order to the trial court for necessary compliance.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
